verdicts.title: Optimization of quantum neuron based on repeat-until-success circuit
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Although the Repeat-Until-Success (RUS) neuron is functionally analogous to the activation function in classical neural networks, its practical application still faces limitations such as high operational complexity and the requirement for binary input states. To address these issues, this paper optimizes the RUS neuron.
